historical_significance.en: Editorial interpretation: a creators’ organisation jointly advances refusal, information, and remuneration mechanisms, recording conditional participation rather than assuming wholesale technological opposition.
historical_significance.original: 编者解释：创作者组织把拒绝训练、知情与报酬机制共同提出，记录有条件参与而非预设全面反对技术。

public_annotation.en: “Implemented” means only that the event occurred; contracts, platforms, and webtoon pilots remained discussion items. Reporting adds 164 member responses from May: 67.7% rejected current conditions and 81.1% were willing under a formal opt-in system. The sample cannot represent all Korean cartoonists; the original questionnaire and complete methodology remain unchecked.
public_annotation.original: implemented仅指活动举行；合同、平台及网漫试点仍是讨论。报道补充5月164份会员回复，67.7%不接受当前条件、81.1%在正式opt-in体系下愿参与；样本不能代表全韩国漫画家，原问卷及完整方法待核。
public_annotation.zh: implemented仅指活动举行；合同、平台及网漫试点仍是讨论。报道补充5月164份会员回复，67.7%不接受当前条件、81.1%在正式opt-in体系下愿参与；样本不能代表全韩国漫画家，原问卷及完整方法待核。

public_annotation.en: Records signing and filing, not an enforcement case. Exceptions include news, public affairs and sports reporting; commentary, criticism, scholarship, satire or parody; qualifying documentary, historical or biographical representations; fleeting or incidental use; and advertising for such works. The documentary exception excludes uses intended to, and actually creating, a false impression that the person participated in a real recording. Term, registration, commercial-value, and other conditions appear in the original statute. This is not a universal ban on AI representations of deceased people.

summary.en: The Beijing Internet Court held online hearings in four illustrators’ cases against developers and operators of AI drawing software. Plaintiffs alleged unauthorised training and generation services infringed their rights and sought cessation and removal of related learning results. Developers and operators raised defences including fair use and absence of substantial similarity; the platform denied supplying works or participating in the disputed conduct.

public_annotation.en: The date is the report webpage’s publication date, not the start of the survey. Open recruitment was not an industry census; NAFCA’s interpretations and respondents’ views are not treated as independently verified facts. Rechecked 20 September 2026: line 73 is questionnaire framing of law at the time, not this archive’s conclusion about current Japanese law. Line 87 reports 57% for self-identified animation workers and 75.5% for non-workers, not population estimates. Free-text comments at lines 93–98 are selected and interpreted by NAFCA; efficiency hopes coexist with concerns over training rights, motivation and international regulatory differences. They do not establish every respondent’s position. Appendix remains Loading/Sign in and unread; chart images and raw data were not independently examined.

public_annotation.en: Read BMI’s Spanish joint announcement, HTML lines 27–43, dated 28 October 2025. Characterisations of unlicensed training are attributed to the organisations. SOCAN’s previously read French guide corroborates the registration policy; the registration interface, actual processing and historical versions were not checked. SOCAN’s specific rules cannot automatically be applied to BMI and ASCAP.

public_annotation.en: The application was filed on 7 September 2023 and the decision issued on 1 December; May 2024 is only the current file path. The initial review did not cover pages 4–8 and did not claim a complete reading. The submitted image, model and prompts remain unexamined; notice, remedies and finality are unresolved. On 17 October 2026, batch 808 rendered and read the remaining printed pages 4–8. Together with batch 807, this covers 11 substantive pages; physical page 12 is blank. Page 4 describes registration as declaratory and evidentiary rather than constitutive of rights; page 5 limits the registration function; pages 6–8 discuss human original expression and distinguish software tools from AI generation of specific expression. These are the authority’s 2023 reasons. Cited laws and cases were not separately obtained, and current law was not comprehensively checked. summary.en: On 30 September 2026, IMPF and IMPEL proposed principles for generative-AI music licensing. They distinguish payments for past uses, training, generated outputs and future exploitation, and call for rightsholder involvement in scope and valuation. This is an industry negotiating framework, not a concluded collective licence or a statutory tariff.
summary.original: 2026 年 9 月 30 日，IMPF 与 IMPEL 联合提出生成式 AI 音乐授权原则，要求区分对既往使用、训练、生成输出及未来利用的支付，并让权利人参与决定授权范围与价值。这是行业组织提出的谈判框架，不是已签订的统一许可协议或法定收费标准。
summary.zh: 2026 年 9 月 30 日，IMPF 与 IMPEL 联合提出生成式 AI 音乐授权原则，要求区分对既往使用、训练、生成输出及未来利用的支付，并让权利人参与决定授权范围与价值。这是行业组织提出的谈判框架，不是已签订的统一许可协议或法定收费标准。

what_changed.en: The statement argues that compositions should be valued at least equally to recordings absent other salient factors. Licences should specify uses; limited pilots should not establish broad precedents; deductions, valuation and reporting should be transparent.
